engine: Vivarium data plane (viv queue + SFE runner + PEW outbox)
world_type: none of its own; one SFE world per queue row, named from the spec hash
organism_type: none (executes registered kinds; no player execution ever built)
pressure_type: none (FIFO single slot; producer-declared outcome rules)
ruler_type: execution facts only: typed tick outcomes, failure classes, pre-registered single-field outcome rule with named aggregate; ledger seal read-back; anchors
scale: ~1,155-1,242 queue rows 2026-09-05..09-18; ~987 observations; one active row globally; 95-193 s per row on the M1 SQLite engine
major_limitations: unit of work (one row = one SFE world) too small and too expensive for evolutionary runs
98% of row time in SFE REST round trips
kinds lag the science; no kind for WSE/program variants
self-parks on idle queue; watchdog escalates through the store it monitors
dormant since 2026-09-18; SFE substrate itself superseded
notable_campaigns: V-2 Archaeon tick (contaminated register; zero fossil input)

world_type: radius-3 binary CA on a periodic 1-D ring (campaign 149 cells, 320 steps), density-classification task
pressure_type: fixed task; IC ensemble (unbiased/Bernoulli/exact-count) labelled as pressure
ruler_type: accuracy under at_T / stable / cellwise criteria, fixed-point facts, witness ICs, exact-symmetry null
scale: C3-2: 150 rows x 4 IC samples; 6-7 named rules + 120 random tables
major_limitations: random rules collapse to 0.0 under at_T/stable (ruler floor)
no adaptation; rules are fixed functions
notable_campaigns: V-3 C3-1 (24 rows lost: null vs [null])
V-4 C3-2 (symmetry null 18/18; acquisition arm structurally void = ruler floor)

engine: cegis_boolean_v1 (Vivarium kind over proteus/eval Boolean VM)
world_type: 3-input Boolean target truth tables (256 possible; 12-task family)
organism_type: enumerated Boolean expression compiled to Proteus VM bytecode
pressure_type: single target task per row; caps on VM ops/oracle calls/candidates; optional transported source pack and component library
ruler_type: solved only on full 8/8 coverage; distinct BUDGET_* statuses; cost counters; library-leak verdicts
major_limitations: fixed enumeration order so only cost can differ
H1 split had zero shared abstractions (library cells ineligible)
most rows exhaust the VM-op cap
notable_campaigns: V-5 H1/H0 alpha (H1 relevance inert; H0 inconclusive; 48 rows first lost to deploy lag)

world_type: 256 elementary CA rules on a 7-cell ring, 8 steps, exhaustive over 128 ICs
ruler_type: behaviour digest + equivalence class vs published class map
major_limitations: H5 quantities at analytic bounds by construction
notable_campaigns: V-6 H5-1 (calibration, not evidence; 24 rows lost to engine stalls; phantom-experiment bursts)

engine: evaluate_bitstring (Vivarium kind over SFE reference executor)
world_type: hidden binary target of length 16/24/32 derived from sha256(seed_root,length); Hamming-agreement score (onemax)
pressure_type: none; proposals from Archaeon's random/weak-signal/fossil policies
ruler_type: score in multiples of 1/L; solved iff 1.0; outcome rule solved == false
scale: hundreds of autonomous rows; S1 24 preregistered rows
major_limitations: each scored fossil leaks exact Hamming information
